scenario.title: A vehicle controller that stops beating while driving opens the contactor
scenario.description: Bring HV up, then take the vehicle controller off the bus. For the first 150 ms of silence no fault may be raised — one or two missed beats are not a failure. By 300 ms after the last beat the fault frame must carry HEARTBEAT_LOST and the contactor must open. Restoring the beats must not clear it, because rule 4 is latched.
